children.value: > Fact From Story: In his column in The Daily Telegraph, Carragher said United's summer signings have led to the club becoming "stale" - and that Ten Hag should now be questioned about whether he can get the best out of his squad.

> > Fact From Story: "In possession we have to do better, but there are reasons and I don't go into them, but everyone is seeing why. But there are also facts so I disagree [with Carragher], we are much better," said Ten Hag. | Supporting Fact

> > > Fact From Story: United host local rivals Manchester City in a Super Sunday derby this weekend, live on Sky Sports with kick-off at 3.30pm, in the latest acid test to see how far Ten Hag's side have improved from last season.
> > > Fact From Story: But in his pre-match press conference for the City game, Ten Hag hit back at those claims.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Managers often give press conferences before games.
> > Fact From Story: But in his pre-match press conference for the City game, Ten Hag hit back at those claims. | Supporting Fact

> > > Fact From Story: In his column in The Daily Telegraph, Carragher said United's summer signings have led to the club becoming "stale" - and that Ten Hag should now be questioned about whether he can get the best out of his squad.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Journalists often write columns expressing their opinions.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A manager is likely to defend their team against criticism. | Commonsense Knowledge

> Fact From Story: Erik ten Hag has disagreed with Jamie Carragher's comments that Manchester United are going backwards this season - by saying the statistics show that his team has actually improved.

> > Fact From Story: In high ball regains, we are a top of the Premier League. In the middle [of the pitch] ball regains, we are top. The pressing is very good. So that's not the truth, what he [Carragher] is telling.
> > > Fact From Story: United are, as he says, "top of the Premier League" in terms of possessions won in the final third and high turnovers.
> > > Fact From Story: Ten Hag is indeed right - Manchester United do rank very highly in their pressing stats in the final two-thirds of the pitch.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Statistics can be used to measure a team's performance.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Statistics can be used to support or refute claims.
> Commonsense Knowledge: People often disagree on subjective evaluations.
